title: Mixtape and Recipe
author: Mirabel Iversen
blurb: Odile Eriksen, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decide who to be when the labels come off, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
